   if ln<loss:
    A,v,H,e,loss=An,vn,Hn,en,ln
    lam=max(lam/2,1e-7)
    break

  if it%5==4:
   print("progress",it,float(np.sqrt(loss)),float(np.max(abs(e))),lam)

def lpfit(A,v,Xb,y,p=4,steps=40,lam=0.001):
 n=len(y)
 H=np.tanh(Xb@A.T); e=H@v[:-1]+v[-1]-y
 def score(e):
  return np.mean(np.abs(e)**p)**(1/p)
 loss=score(e)
 for it in range(steps):
  J=(((1-H*H)*v[:-1])[:,:,None]*Xb[:,None,:]).reshape(n,-1)
  J=np.c_[J,H,np.ones(n)]
  w=np.maximum(abs(e),np.max(abs(e))*1e-6)**(p-2)
  w=w/np.mean(w)
  G=(J.T*w)@J/n; g=J.T@(w*e)/n
  for trial in range(12):
   d=np.linalg.solve(G+lam*np.diag(np.maximum(np.diag(G),1e-4)),-g)
   accepted=False
   for ratio in [1,0.5,0.25,0.125,0.0625,0.03125]:
    An=A+ratio*d[:A.size].reshape(A.shape); vn=v+ratio*d[A.size:]
    Hn=np.tanh(Xb@An.T); en=Hn@vn[:-1]+vn[-1]-y; ln=score(en)
    if ln<loss-1e-13:
     A,v,H,e,loss=An,vn,Hn,en,ln
     lam=max(lam/2,1e-7)
     accepted=True
     break
   if accepted: break
   lam=min(lam*5,1e6)
  if not accepted: break
 return A,v,lam,float(np.sqrt(np.mean(e*e))),float(np.max(abs(e)))
